avis.titre: Brightening Cream That Works Without Irritating My Dry/Mature SkinBrightening Cream That Works Without Irritating My Dry
avis.texte: At 52, post-menopausal, with dry, increasingly sensitive skin, I’m very careful with brightening products. Many of them can be too aggressive, especially when they include ingredients like arbutin or tranexamic acid. I’m always looking for formulas that improve overall tone gradually without causing dryness or irritation. This cream fits that role very well. This is not a harsh brightening treatment, and that’s actually one of its strengths. Instead of pushing too hard, it works more as a steady maintenance product that helps improve overall skin tone over time. That’s exactly what I prefer at this stage. The texture is also very well done. It’s lightweight but still feels hydrating enough to function as a cream. It spreads easily, absorbs quickly, and doesn’t leave any heaviness on the skin. There’s no stickiness, no greasiness, and no pilling, even when layered over serums or under sunscreen. What I notice most is how this helps my skin look more even and smooth over time. This isn’t an overnight product, and I don’t expect dramatic results from something like this. Instead, it’s more about gradual improvement in tone and overall skin quality, which is often more realistic and sustainable. This also works very well for daytime use, especially if you live in warm weather or humidity. Because it’s lightweight, it doesn’t feel heavy or suffocating, and it layers easily with the rest of my routine. I also appreciate how gentle and skin-compatible this cream feels. Even with rel

This product definitely works on my caucasian skin. I work outdoors and wanted to even out my weird tan lines. After 10 days of use (applying once or twice a day, and I think I did skip a day or two by accident) I can see a significant difference. I always start with applying the cream to my cheeks and as a result, my cheeks have lightened in color much more than other parts of my face. Whoops! I also did not work the product in to my eyebrows, and there is a noticeable difference in shade there too. Long story short, be sure to apply the product evenly or you WILL get patchy results! Next steps for me: continuing with more thorough application and attacking my forearms to fade this farmer’s tan.

This a fantastic product! It works wonderfully at brightening my skin and improving my dark spots. It is light and goes on easily. Because it contains retinol and other anti-aging ingredients, it seems to help tighten my skin and improve the appearance of lines and wrinkles. I use it three times a week at night, and I have noticed a major improvement in the texture and appearance of my skin!

I wake up everyday with glowing skin I am shocked! I am beyond happy. One thing to always remember is that whenever you go outdoors and it's sunny, make sure to use a good sunscreen.

avis.titre: Lightweight and gentle but not very effective
avis.texte: I had severe acne in my 20s and early 30s, and unfortunately, I’m still dealing with the PIH acne scars left behind in my 40s. I’ve tried several topical treatments over the years to fade these stubborn dark marks, but I haven’t had much success. I’ve been using the TOSOWOONG Arbutin 7% + Tranexamic Acid 4% Cream 3 times a week for 12 weeks, and unfortunately, I haven’t noticed any significant fading or lightening of my acne scars. I was really hoping to see some improvement after using it consistently for three months, but my PIH looks essentially unchanged. That said, there are some things I do like about this cream. It’s lightweight, has never caused me any irritation, and a little goes a long way. I only need about a pea-sized amount, so the tube lasts quite a while. My only complaint with the texture is that it can feel a little sticky or tacky after application. Since I haven’t experienced any irritation, I’m going to increase my use to nightly application and see if using it more frequently makes a difference. However, based on my experience so far, I don’t plan to repurchase it once I finish the tube.

So far, no noticeable results. But I've only been using it for about a week. So we will see!! Love the formula though! The only thing is, a little goes a long way! If you use too much, it will start to ball up but 10/10 definitely recommend!

avis.titre: It works, but requires a consistent routine!
avis.texte: I’m here to report back after having used this product for a little over one month straight. My issue started out over a month ago with a couple of pimples around my chin and lip area at which point the affected area started getting bigger after applying a pimple patch. The patch actually made the pimple worst and affected the surrounding area. I’m prone to hyperpigmentation which made me freak out as the area is very very prominent and noticeable. I did some internet digging until I found this gem of a product. I should also mention that I had already been using Dr.Idriss Major Fade system (she’s a big derm in the YouTube world). The cream in itself is very light, but unless you really work it into the skin - it can leave behind white flakey residue. And here lies in the solution: if I’m not going anywhere during the day or even sleeping at night, I leave a nice dollop of the cream without rubbing it into the skin at all and it seemed to have worked. The whole point is to prevent tyrosine from being activated to melanin which is what cause the hyperpigmentation to begin with. The more the better I suppose 🤔. I also used this in conjunction with a form of lactic acid for exfoliations to remove the dead skin cells about 3x weekly, niacinamide face wash daily, this cream and layered it with moisturizers which include vitamin c in it. It took about a month to completely disappear one of the scars on my chin but still working on the naso-labial area scar. It takes patience, pers

I was looking for an effective over the counter skin lightener to help with hyperpigmentation, uneven skin tone, age spots, and fine wrinkles caused by years of sun exposure without proper protection. I prefer Korean skincare products because Koreans take skin care seriously, and I like they take men's skin heath just as seriously. I’ve always had great experiences with Korean skincare products. This arbutin 7.0 and tranexamic acid 4.0 cream seemed like a great choice to tackle these issues. I know results won’t be immediate. It will take time, product use consistency, and sun protection on my part to see improvements. So far, I can say that it applies smoothly, even with just a pea sized amount. It has a creamy, silky texture and doesn’t irritate or dry out my skin. When I wake up in the morning, my skin still feels soft and hydrated. I’ll continue using it and look forward to seeing long term results.

TOSOWOONG Arbutin 7% + Tranexamic Acid 4% Cream comes in a 1.69 fl oz tube with a seal that needs to be punctured to open. It is a lightweight cream with a medium to thick texture. The active ingredients such as Arbutin and tranexamic acid are targeting skin with discolorations. I use it all over my face because I have age spots as well as sun spots. I also use it both in the morning and at night. I also make sure that I wear sunscreen during the day. I have not experienced any negative effects.

The star ingredients in the cream are arbutin and tranexamic acid, targeting hyperpigmentation (also glutathione, but further down the list). How well the formula works for me only time will tell. Cream is white and fairly thin, spreads easily and soaks well, I experienced no irritation. Has hydrating and soothing ingredients also – such as ethylhexyl palmitate, glycerin, stearyl alcohol, allantoin, squalane, centella asiatica extract – however for PM use in the winter I top it with an emollient night cream or facial oil for more moisture. Full ingredient list in my photo.
